earnings.title: First Solar, Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results, Updates Guidance, and Announces $500 Million Share Repurchase Program
highlights: Net sales of $1.23 billion, a decrease of 23% year-over-year
Net income per diluted share of $5.30, an increase of 25% year-over-year
Net sales were $1.23 billion for the third quarter of 2026, a 23% decrease compared to the third quarter of 2025, driven primarily by a decrease in the volume of modules sold to third parties.
The Company reported third quarter net income of $571 million, or $5.30 per diluted share, compared to $456 million, or $4.24 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025.
First Solar board of directors authorizes $500 million share repurchase program

items.heading: Competition in solar markets globally and across the solar value chain is intense and could remain that way for an extended period of time. The solar industry may experience periods of structural imbalance between global PV module supply and demand that result in periods of pricing volatility, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
